address: 41 Church Road, Brighton and Hove, BN3 2BE, United Kingdom
bio: Brighton and Hove’s laidback bohemian spirit is strong in this buzzy bistro that delivers a fun time with flavour-packed cooking to boot. The front of the Edwardian shop conversion is the bar, a haven for cocktail lovers and vinyl enthusiasts, that hosts a resident DJ on weekends. To the rear is the cosy little bistro, where plates both large and small can be enjoyed among friends, along with a selection of steaks and fish from the blackboard. The well-chosen wine list is sensibly priced and big on natural options, while the welcoming service is the cherry on top.
